{{recipesummary|category=Cookie recipes| Yield = 15–20 squares|time=50–55 minutes|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}}

A delicious square recipe with a pleasant flavor of oranges and cranberries.

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (240 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) rolled [[Cookbook:oats|oats]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (240 g) [[Cookbook:Flour|all-purpose flour]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (180 g) [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (120 g) [[Cookbook:butter|butter]] (melted)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (240 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) whole [[Cookbook:Cranberry Sauce|cranberry sauce]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Orange|orange juice]]

==Procedure==
#Lightly oil a a square [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]], and line it with [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment paper]].
#In a [[Cookbook:Mixing Bowl|mixing bowl]], combine the rolled oats, flour, sugar, and baking soda using a [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]].
#Using your hands, mix the melted butter into the rolled oats mixture, until it forms pea-sized clumps. Do not over mix.
#Reserve 1 ½ cups (360 g) of mixture to be used as the topping.
#Press remainder of oat mix into the bottom of the pan, making sure it covers the whole bottom.
#Mix the orange juice with the cranberry sauce.
#Spread evenly over the base.
#Sprinkle the reserved oats mixture over the top.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|350°F]] (180°C) for 40 minutes, or until golden brown.
#Cool and cut into squares.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*This recipe can be doubled to fit a 13 x 9-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (30 x 24 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) pan.
